info.title: FantasyEdge API
info.description: Fantasy football team advisor. Data: Sleeper, nflverse (CC-BY 4.0), FantasyCalc, DynastyProcess.

post.description: Look up a Sleeper user's leagues and teams for the current season (no full sync yet).

get.description: League ID and whether cookies are set in the local .env (the cookies themselves stay put).

post.description:
Connect an ESPN league (private leagues need the espn_s2 and SWID cookies, which are
stored only in the local database). Data flows in from ESPN only; nothing is written there.

get.description: Whether ESPN cookies are saved for this league (last 4 characters only).

put.description: Replace expired ESPN cookies. They're checked against ESPN before being saved.

post.description: Pick your team; syncs the league's rosters, transactions and market values if needed.
Create a league from a hand-entered roster (works for any platform).

get.description: Roster with projections, ROS value, market value, flags and grades vs the league.

delete.description:
Delete a manual team, or forget a Sleeper/ESPN league (with its saved ESPN login) from
FantasyEdge. Nothing changes on Sleeper or ESPN; connect again any time.

get.description:
Every player with a projection: search, filter by position / NFL team / who has him,
sort by PPG, ROS points, value, market value or verdict, paged on the server.
Bio, verdict, weekly statlines and projected-vs-actual points for one player.

Trades built around one player: if he's yours, deals that give him away (1 or 2 players
back); if he's on another team, packages of 1-2 of your players for him. Deals the other
lineup also likes come first.

parameters.name: want

schema.description: When he's yours: the position you want back
schema.title: Want

parameters.description: When he's yours: the position you want back

get.description: Players the market undervalues vs our projection (buy), and your overvalued ones (sell).

Top N per position by schedule-adjusted points, for each upcoming week and the rest of
the season (all players; owner labeled).

Your real lineup and the best lineup for a week (matchup-adjusted projections), with the
positions each slot accepts and who is locked (game already final) or on IR. Read-only: the
planner never changes your lineup on the platform.

Free agents ranked by net rest-of-season gain to your starting lineup (after the best
drop), with a FAAB bid range, plus Sleeper's most-added players of the last 24 hours.
Ranked advisor feed (Trade / Sell / Buy / Waiver / Lineup / Bye prep) + team grades.
TD over expected, efficiency outliers and usage/production mismatches.
Week × lineup-slot grid of remaining byes with danger weeks.

put.description: Edit a manual team: name, scoring, league size, lineup/bench/IR depth and players.

post.description: Score a trade by its effect on both teams' rest-of-season starting lineups.

get.description:
1-for-1 and 2-for-1 ideas where both lineups gain after any forced drops, and neither team
is left short in a week it can fill today (hidden after the trade deadline).

parameters.name: page

schema.description: 0 = best ideas; each page shows new deals
schema.title: Page

parameters.description: 0 = best ideas; each page shows new deals

post.description:
"Trade these players for a RB": deals across the league that improve your lineup, the ones
the other team should like first.

put.description:
Your what-if for one player: out for the season, or back in a given week. It changes
FantasyEdge's projections only (every page, every league), never ESPN or Sleeper.

delete.description: Drop your what-if: back to the injury report.

get.description: Every team you've connected or entered, for the team switcher.

post.description: Re-pull league rosters/transactions (scope=league), market values, or everything.

get.description: Player search (used by manual team entry). Full players table arrives in phase 3.
Every setting with its current value, default, allowed range and help text.

put.description: Change some settings (others keep their saved values). Every page recomputes.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Metric key → value; null = no data

has_market.title: Has Market
has_market.description: False when the market doesn't value this position

starter_line.title: Starter Line
starter_line.description: Rank of the first non-starter league-wide at this position

buy.title: Buy
buy.description: Undervalued players on other teams / free agents

market_implied_points.title: Market Implied Points
market_implied_points.description: ROS points of the player we rank where the market ranks him

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: starter: we rank him above the league's starter line; depth: bench / sleeper

CredentialsOut.title: CredentialsOut
CredentialsOut.description: Saved ESPN cookies, masked: only the last 4 characters ever leave the backend.

season.title: Season
season.description: Defaults to the current NFL season

unmatched.title: Unmatched
unmatched.description: ESPN players we couldn't match to our player data (shown with 0 projection)

EspnDefaultsOut.title: EspnDefaultsOut
EspnDefaultsOut.description: What the local .env provides, so the Connect form can be pre-filled (never the cookies).

scoring_preset.title: Scoring Preset
scoring_preset.description: Preset key when the rules match one exactly

scoring_notes.title: Scoring Notes
scoring_notes.description: League scoring rules FantasyEdge can't model yet

roster_positions.title: Roster Positions
roster_positions.description: Starting slots plus one 'BN' per bench spot and one 'IR' per IR spot (bench depth varies by league).

player_ids.title: Player Ids
player_ids.description: Everyone on the roster (starters, bench and IR)

starters.title: Starters
starters.description: Subset of player_ids in the starting lineup; must fit the starting slots. Empty = we pick the best lineup.

ir.title: Ir
ir.description: Subset of player_ids stashed on IR

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True when using a fallback source or another format

index.title: Index
index.description: Opponent's fantasy points allowed to the position vs average (>1 easier)

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: Shortest window first; Season is last

injury_detail.title: Injury Detail
injury_detail.description: Injury report detail, e.g. 'Knee - ACL, surgery'

return_week.title: Return Week
return_week.description: First week he can play when known (99 = out for the season)

availability_source.title: Availability Source
availability_source.description: rule: season-ending injury in the report; override: your what-if

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Fantasy team that rosters him (None = nobody)

statline_keys.title: Statline Keys
statline_keys.description: Statline columns for this position, in order

analytics.description: None for K/DEF or no games

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team name, 'Your team', 'Free agent', or None

ros_points.title: Ros Points
ros_points.description: Schedule-adjusted projected points, rest of season

return_week.title: Return Week
return_week.description: First week he can play when known (99 = out for the season)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: sell: he's yours (deals giving him away); buy: on another team (what it takes to get him); free_agent / unavailable: no trades, see message

projected.title: Projected
projected.description: What we projected before that week

nfl_teams.title: Nfl Teams
nfl_teams.description: NFL teams in the pool, for the team filter

z.title: Z
z.description: Standard deviations above the comparison-league average

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: How strongly matchups move this position (0 = not at all)

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team name, 'Free agent', or None if unknown

points.title: Points
points.description: Matchup-adjusted projected points (week or rest of season)

neutral_points.title: Neutral Points
neutral_points.description: Same projection against an average schedule

schedule_delta.title: Schedule Delta
schedule_delta.description: points - neutral_points: what the schedule adds

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: Weekly view: that week; ROS: next few opponents

top.title: Top
top.description: How many players per position each list holds

ppg.title: Ppg
ppg.description: Projected fantasy points per game (league scoring)

return_week.title: Return Week
return_week.description: First week he can play when known (99 = out for the season)

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Our projection vs the market: one verdict used everywhere

value_gap.title: Value Gap
value_gap.description: Model ROS points minus what the market's price implies

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: Platform slot: starter | bench | ir | taxi

optimal_starter.title: Optimal Starter
optimal_starter.description: In this week's best lineup (players on bye or ruled out can't be in it)

on_bye.title: On Bye
on_bye.description: His NFL team doesn't play this week

has_login.title: Has Login
has_login.description: ESPN login cookies saved for this league

tuned.title: Tuned
tuned.description: Default was picked by the walk-forward backtest

current.title: Current
current.description: Your real lineup, one player id per slot

optimal.title: Optimal
optimal.description: The best lineup, one player id per slot

has_lineup.title: Has Lineup
has_lineup.description: False when the platform gave no starters (manual team)

points.title: Points
points.description: Projected points this week (matchup-adjusted; 0 if done)

return_week.title: Return Week
return_week.description: First week he can play when known (99 = out for the season)

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: His game this week is already final: he can't be moved

reserved.title: Reserved
reserved.description: On IR or taxi: can't be started

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: Lineup slot key (QB, RB, FLEX, SUPER_FLEX, ...)

grade_basis.title: Grade Basis
grade_basis.description: What the grades are compared against

partner.description: Null for a hypothetical trade with players not on a league roster

partner_accepts.title: Partner Accepts
partner_accepts.description: Whether the other lineup gains too (null for a hypothetical trade)

drops.title: Drops
drops.description: Players this team must release to stay at its roster limit

new_short_weeks.title: New Short Weeks
new_short_weeks.description: Weeks it could fill its lineup before the trade but can't after (byes/injuries)

has_more.title: Has More

adds.title: Adds

ros_points.title: Ros Points
ros_points.description: His schedule-adjusted projected points, rest of season

gain.title: Gain

drop.description: Who you'd release (None: open roster spot)

fixes_weeks.title: Fixes Weeks
fixes_weeks.description: Weeks you can't fill a slot today that he fills

need.title: Need

return_week.title: Return Week

before.title: Before
